title: discovery_prompt
description: The instruction text sent to the AI for one finder, kept as data so the Console can show and edit exactly what goes into the calls (see DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md and DISCOVERY_PROMPT_GUIDE.md). Versions are linked records, the same pattern as message_template: a draft is edited in place; publishing turns the draft into the new published record, whose previous_id names the record it replaces; the standing version is the published record nobody supersedes. Rules the schema cannot express: at most one draft and one standing published record per finder; every {placeholder} must be one the finder supplies (territory, types, fields, max_results for the venue finder) and curly braces are used only for placeholders; a finder with no published prompt cannot run; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept. Every published version stays so a run's prompt_version can be explained. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

finder_key.description: Which finder this prompt is for, such as venue. Must be a registered finder. Required.

name.description: A plain-words name shown in the Console. Up to 120 characters. Required.

text.description: The instruction text, with {placeholder} slots the system fills from the operator's choices. 20 to 12,000 characters. Required.

status.description: draft (being edited, never sent) or published (the version a run may use). Set by the server.

version.description: 1 for the first published version, then one more each time a draft is published; a draft carries the number it will get. Set by the server.

previous_id.description: The published record this one replaces or was copied from. Absent on the first version. Set by the server.

published_at.description: When the draft was published (UTC); absent while a draft. Set by the server.

published_by.description: Who published it, as an actor string; absent while a draft. Set by the server.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
